title: Urban Craft
description: A Forge 1.20.1 city-building & urban survival modpack. Build cities, drive vehicles, manage an economy, survive seasons and temperature, and live in a world that feels truly alive.

![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/17546b5153953ce643bb5ff5edeef13d008911e9_0.webp)

## What is Urban Craft?
Urban Craft is a Forge 1.20.1 modpack that transforms Minecraft into a rich, immersive urban survival experience. Build sprawling cities, manage your economy, survive realistic weather and temperature, and live a life that feels genuinely alive. Whether you're an architect, a merchant, a driver, or just a city dweller, Urban Craft has something for you.

# Features

## 🏗️ Build Your City
With the complete **Macaw's suite** — roads, pavings, bridges, doors, windows, fences, lights, roofs, stairs, and trapdoors, paintings — you have everything you need to construct a fully detailed, realistic city from the ground up. Add architectural depth with **Framed Blocks**, **Architects Palette**, **Builders Addition**, **Copycats+**, and **Citresewn** for limitless creative freedom.
Decorate interiors with **Mcw Furniture**, hang signs and direction arrows with **Signpost** and **Supplementaries**, and line your streets with working lamps and urban details. **CityCraft** gives you various types of road signs and road blocks.

## 🌡️ Survive the Environment
The world is not just a backdrop — it will challenge you. **Cold Sweat** introduces a full temperature system: stay warm in winter, find shade in summer, or face the physical consequences of ignoring the climate. **Serene Seasons** brings four beautiful, dynamic seasons that change the landscape around you throughout the year. **Particle Rain** and **Falling Leaves **make every storm and autumn breeze feel cinematic and alive.

## 🍽️ Eat Well, Live Well
**Farmer's Delight** overhauls cooking with realistic recipes, cutting boards, and new ingredients. **Diet** tracks your nutritional balance — eating the same food every day will slow you down, so keep your meals varied.** AppleSkin** keeps you informed about hunger and saturation at all times.

## 💰 Economy & Trade
Build a functioning economy with **Lightman's Currency** — mint physical coins, open shops, and trade with other players or villagers. **Villager Names** gives every NPC a unique identity, making your city feel populated with real citizens rather than identical merchants. **Guard Villagers** keeps your streets safe with armed patrols day and night.

## 🚗 Transportation & Mobility
Hit the road with **Immersive Vehicles** — drive cars, trucks, and more through your city streets with realistic vehicle physics. Expand your transport network with **Steam Rails** and the **MTS Official Pack** along with the **UNU Civilian and Parts Packs**, adding trains, trams, and public transit infrastructure to your world. Plan every route with **Xaero's Minimap** and **Xaero's World Map**, and set waypoints across your entire urban sprawl. **Trafficcraft** adds road signs and traffic infrastructure to keep your city streets organized.

## ⚙️ Technology & Automation
**Create** brings mechanical engineering to your city — build factories, automate production lines, and power your infrastructure with gears, belts, and steam engines. **Create Addition**, **Create Deco**, and **Escalated** expand the ecosystem even further. Devices adds interactive gadgets and tech blocks that bring a modern, smart-city feel to your builds.

## 🔊 Immersive Audio & Visuals
**Sound Physics Remastered** gives every sound realistic reverb and echo — hear your footsteps bounce off city walls and rain echo through alleyways. **Ambient Sounds** fills every corner of the world with environmental audio. **Presence Footsteps** adds distinct sounds for every surface you walk on, from cobblestone to grass to asphalt. **Drip Sounds** adds realistic water dripping in underground spaces. **Entity Texture Features** and **Entity Model Features** make every mob feel visually unique with randomized textures and improved animations.
**Distant Horizons** pushes your view distance far beyond vanilla limits, letting you admire your entire city skyline from miles away — perfect for screenshots and appreciating your hard work.

## 🔫 Security & Combat
Protect your city with **SecurityCraft** — set up security cameras, laser tripwires, alarm systems, and reinforced doors to keep intruders out. **TACZ** brings a modern, realistic firearms system with detailed weapon models and mechanics for those who want to take city defense seriously.

## 🎒 Storage & Organization
**Sophisticated Backpacks** gives you tiered, upgradeable backpacks so you can carry everything you need on long building sessions. **Mouse Tweaks** makes inventory management far smoother and faster.

## 🌳A Living World
**Dynamic Trees** and **Dynamic Trees Plus** replace vanilla tree generation with realistic, gradually growing trees that fall when chopped. **Falling Leaves** adds gentle particle effects to foliage. **Visuality** enhances visual feedback with particles and effects that make the world feel more reactive and alive.

## ⚡Performance

Urban Craft is built to run smoothly even with its large mod list. The pack includes **Embeddium**, **Oculus**, **FerriteCore**, **ModernFix**, **Starlight**, **Saturn**, **Radium**, **Rubidium Extra**, **Entity Culling**, **Memory Leak Fix**, and **Smooth Boot (Reloaded)** to keep your game fast and stable on a wide range of hardware.

## 🔧Requirements

Minecraft: **1.20.1**\
Mod Loader: Forge **47.4.20**\
Minimum RAM: **6 GB allocated**\
Recommended RAM: **8 GB or more**\
Java: **Java 17**

# ❓ FAQ
**Is this modpack multiplayer compatible?**  
Yes! Urban Craft is fully designed with multiplayer in mind. Most mods work on servers — just install the server-side mods and make sure your friends use the same modpack version.

**How much RAM do I need?**  
We recommend allocating at least 6 GB of RAM, with 8 GB being the sweet spot for a smooth experience. If you use Distant Horizons at high settings, consider going up to 10 GB.

**Can I add my own mods?**  
Yes, but proceed with caution. Urban Craft already includes a large number of mods, so adding more increases the chance of conflicts. Always test new mods one at a time.

**Does this work with shaders?**  
Yes! The pack includes Oculus and Embeddium which support shader packs. We recommend Complementary Reimagined in Lite mode for the best balance between visuals and performance.

**Is OptiFine supported?**  
No. OptiFine is incompatible with many mods in this pack. Use Embeddium + Oculus instead — they provide the same features with far better compatibility.
